calls.title: thoughts on pricing
calls.summary: The team discussed the transition to a usage-based pricing model aimed at better capturing value from high-activity users and aligning with industry standards. Key points included the advantages of usage-based pricing over flat increases, with examples such as Kalshi's contract showcasing flexible pricing. Static's pricing structure was detailed, highlighting different tiers and event-based charges. Customer segmentation revealed that smaller enterprises with high experimentation could generate large contracts, with companies like Tubi demonstrating this potential. The competitive landscape is shifting, as Static plans to stop new enterprise contracts by March, signaling a focus change. There is a recognized need to simplify pricing complexity for improved customer experience and smoother upgrade paths.
calls.keywords: usage-based pricing, enterprise contracts, event-based pricing, experiment pricing, Statsig acquisition, pricing model consolidation
